skill.name: wechat-mp-article-extract
skill.description: Extract WeChat public account article metadata, body text, media links, and related articles from supplied links or share text through SocialDataX.
skill.summary: Organize returned WeChat article data into readable sections without inventing missing fields.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One command finding is confirmed: the documented CLI downloads and executes an unpinned npm package through npx without an installation prompt. The other 25 findings concern Markdown syntax, legitimate service links, credential variable names, and readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection or credential exfiltration in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not available for review.

remediation.issue: The CLI example executes socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y, trusting a mutable external package without an installation prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain user approval before initial package installation and execution.

content.user_title: Extract WeChat Articles into Structured Notes
content.value_statement: WeChat article links can be difficult to organize for research and editorial work. This skill uses SocialDataX to organize returned article text, metadata, and media links.
actual_capabilities: Accept mp.weixin.qq.com article links or share text containing a supported link.
Request article details through the SocialDataX CLI or an already connected article-detail MCP tool.
Organize returned titles, account names, publication times, and original article links.
Present returned body paragraphs in order without adding unsupported information.
List returned image links, embedded video cards, and related article links in separate sections.
Identify missing fields and follow documented retry and insufficient-balance handling.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX credentials and network access; CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.
Service balance and article availability can limit retrieval; missing fields cannot be reconstructed.
Does not discover other articles, list account histories, retrieve comments, or provide engagement metrics.
The CLI uses an external npm package; its implementation and runtime behavior are not included in these skill files.

use_cases.title: Prepare source notes
use_cases.description: Turn a supplied WeChat article into organized source text, publication metadata, and related links for later analysis.

use_cases.title: Review article assets
use_cases.description: Separate returned article paragraphs, image links, and embedded video cards for an editorial review.

use_cases.title: Build a reference record
use_cases.description: Create a consistent article record with the original URL and explicit notices for unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Extract one article
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract this WeChat article: [article URL]. Show the returned title, account, publication time, and body. Mark missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve a single supported article.

prompt_templates.title: Process shared text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the article linked in this share text: [share text]. Keep body paragraphs in order and include the original article URL.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: work from a copied share message.

prompt_templates.title: Separate media and related content
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract [article URL]. Separate article information, body, media links, and related articles. Include only returned fields and identify missing content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a complete reference record.

prompt_templates.title: Use an existing MCP connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the connected wechat_get_mp_article_detail_by_url tool for [article URL]. Preserve body order, separate media and related links, and report unavailable fields without substitutions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use an already configured MCP article tool.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: extract a supported article whose response includes a title and body but no media.
output: Article information: title, account, publication time, and original URL appear when returned.
Body: returned paragraphs appear in their original order.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: extract an article when SocialDataX reports insufficient balance.
output: Article extraction could not finish because the service reported insufficient balance.
No repeated retries were made. Extraction can resume after the balance issue is resolved.

best_practices: Provide a complete supported article link and verify which fields the service actually returns.
Keep credentials in SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and exclude secret values from prompts, logs, and shared outputs.
Approve a reviewed, pinned CLI package before execution, or use an already configured MCP connection.
anti_patterns: Concatenating raw share text into a shell command without safe argument handling.
Inventing missing body text, images, publication metadata, or related articles.
Repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors or making unauthorized global environment changes.

faq.question: Which inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Provide an mp.weixin.qq.com article URL or share text containing that URL. WeChat Channels videos are outside this skill's scope.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network access. CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the alternative requires an already connected article-detail MCP tool.

faq.question: Which article fields can it return?
faq.answer: It organizes returned titles, account names, publication times, body paragraphs, image links, embedded video cards, and related articles. Availability depends on the response.

faq.question: Does it log into or modify my WeChat account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, browser-data access, and account changes.

faq.question: What happens when the service balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: The workflow stops repeated retries and shows the SocialDataX billing link. Resume after resolving the balance issue.

faq.question: Is the external CLI implementation included?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents an npm command using the latest package version. Review and pin the package before allowing execution.
